components.name: Perspective choices
components.description: Opening controls name three physical worlds around aspects of one design; Hydra renders the focal objects and set separately.
components.css: .ds-choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);text-align:center}.ds-choice{position:relative;min-height:65px;min-width:170px;justify-self:center;padding:14px 24px 20px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--paper,#f1f0e3);cursor:pointer}.ds-choice strong{display:block;font:400 31px Thaddeus,Georgia,serif}.ds-choice span{display:block;margin-top:7px;color:var(--muted,#bbd1cb);font:11px DIN,Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.025em}.ds-choice:hover strong{color:var(--gold,#e5cb91)}.ds-choice:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold,#e5cb91);outline-offset:5px}.ds-choice:disabled{cursor:wait;opacity:.4}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-choice{padding:12px 6px 17px;min-width:0}.ds-choice strong{font-size:21px;line-height:1.1}.ds-choice span{font-size:10px;max-width:11ch;margin:8px auto 0;line-height:1.45}}.ds-choice:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:3px;left:50%;width:38px;height:1px;background:var(--gold,#e5cb91);transform:translateX(-50%) scaleX(.36);opacity:.3;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .5s}.ds-choice:is(:hover,:focus-visible):after{transform:translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);opacity:1}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-choice:after{transition:none}}@media(max-width:380px){.ds-choice strong{font-size:19px}.ds-choice span{font-size:9px}}@media(max-width:340px){.ds-choice strong{font-size:17px}}

narrative.overview:
The supplied campaign establishes petrol shadow, turquoise light, emerald depth and warm gold. The local implementation gives these materials a physical setting: cut-glass architecture, folded silk, an obsidian ground and a distant photographic wall. Cormorant's high-contrast serif voice and DIN controls keep the interface quiet around the staged objects.

Three materially distinct worlds reveal one jewellery design. The Stone suspends a free emerald among smoked cut-glass forms; The Setting turns the ring to expose its basket and split shank over folded teal silk; The Presence poses the complete ring diagonally in a light chamber with a campaign portrait on the back wall. They share the preserved native Hydra selector, camera, drag and touch journey rather than adding pages or another renderer.
keyCharacteristics: Three authored setpieces with distinct focal forms: gemstone, setting profile and complete ring.
Physical native meshes, restrained atmospheric light and supplied photographic material.
A continuous spatial journey with full-screen editorial product and campaign overlays.
Short serif statements, selective italic emphasis and quiet DIN controls.
Native motion, opt-in sound, reduced-motion and content-recovery states.

rules.name: The Warm Action Rule
rules.body: Use gold to identify action, selection or focus. Keep the room cool; material light and supplied photographs provide the richer colour.

rules.name: The Object First Rule
rules.body: Reserve the focal object's animated silhouette before placing display copy. Keep statements short and preserve authored line breaks where they define a world.

rules.name: The Scene Continuity Rule
rules.body: Use same-document overlays for details, campaign and utilities. Preserve the native camera position and restore scene input after closing.

rules.name: The Native Depth Rule
rules.body: Extend native meshes, shaders and the existing clock. Keep geometric focal objects and their environments distinct from supporting bitmap cutouts.

dos: **Do** preserve the continuous native selector, camera, drag and touch journey.
**Do** give each world its own focal form and physical material setting.
**Do** retain supplied campaign imagery and protect its photographic content.
**Do** reserve the focal object's full motion envelope and keep controls outside it.
**Do** preserve full-width phone overlays, internal scrolling and reachable close controls.
**Do** describe local drafts, storage and downloads truthfully.
donts: **Don't** reduce the worlds to repeated identical rings on an empty teal field.
**Don't** turn three aspects of one creation into three invented products.
**Don't** add a replacement renderer, animation clock or stacked shop structure.
**Don't** substitute the supporting PNG for the interactive geometric focal object.
**Don't** invent commercial facts, a working checkout or sent-message status.
**Don't** extend compact scene captions into general reading-size defaults.
